title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is steady. Kula Ag had mostly shade over the last hour; the cloud tops out between about 6,900 and 9,800 ft, with sun above it. The upslope is ending: the slope has nearly stopped gaining heat since about 16:00. Trades are holding the shear line north of Makawao, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
